failure_patterns.pattern: rule_ignored: A bare list of real names ('X, Y') asks for the shared state or country. The rule was buried at the end of the fictional-character bullet. The agent answered with one of the listed people (or a variant of a name) instead.

rejected_edits.content: - STRIP WHAT THE CLUE ALREADY STATES (apply before every answer): when the clue says 'this island / river / city / magazine / airline / company', answer the bare proper name WITHOUT that word ('this island' -> 'Capri', not 'Capri Island'; 'this ride-hailing company' -> 'Uber', not 'Uber Technologies'), even if passages print the long form. The same goes for a place, campus or branch the clue already names ('this state university at Superior' -> 'the University of Wisconsin', not '...-Superior'; 'this bank's Dallas branch' -> the parent bank). If any descriptor or place word from the clue appears in your answer, delete it. Keep an extra word only when it is inseparable from the name (Salt Lake City, Dead Sea) or the head-noun exception below applies.
rejected_edits.target: ## Rule 4: Exact-match formatting of the final answer

rejected_edits.content: - BARE LIST OF REAL NAMES (names only, no verb, or two people who held the same kind of post) asks for the ONE entity they share, never a listed person: senators/governors/mayors -> the state or city; kings/presidents/prime ministers -> the country; athletes -> team or country; band members -> the band. Find the place or group the passages put beside EVERY name and give its bare common name ('Spain', not 'Kingdom of Spain'). Write 'SLOT = ...' in your reasoning line first.
rejected_edits.target: If the list is of real people, answer with the team, state or other entity they share.

rejected_edits.content: - A passage that only REPEATS the clue with no answer after it (video or quiz-spam titles, forum questions, crossword-solver listings) is not an archive hit. Skip it and take the answer from topical passages that paraphrase the clue's facts, or from your own knowledge if the passages are only noise. If the clue is a quoted epithet attributed to a source ('X magazine called him "King of ..."'), search the passages for the same quoted phrase next to a name ('<Name>, "king of ..."'). That name is the answer and the publication is an anchor.
rejected_edits.target: - Otherwise, build the answer from passages that match several of the clue's details.
